x: Dick Negus and Boxall of the Juniors and Leigh have possibilities, but need to do a lot of study of technique to show their best. The Hop, Step and Jump, rather a neglected event heretofore, we have tried to popularise by including the event in matches.
High Jump : 1 Basted (Poly), 2 Negus (Bel.), 3 Boxall (Bel.). 5ft. 4in. Long Jump : 1 Swaysland (Poly), 2 Negus (Bel.), 3 Basted (Poly). 18ft.
Boxall was second in the High Jump, and this lad can always be relied upon to turn up for this event and should improve with careful coaching.
Boxall, who did 5 feet 3 inches; Nickini, who was second in the Senior Championship; Cooper and Whitehead should all show improvement in the High Jump next year.
